https://pon.wiki/guides/masquerade-as-the-att-inc-bgw620-700...
After putting my iPhone in lockdown mode > disconnecting my ATT fiber PON (leaving the router on) > going to WiFi settings in iOS > disabling Connectivity Assist and crucially > “Reset Data Usage”, iOS informed me that my certificate expired in May of 2025. items.title: Show HN: Blackgit – use Git to only download those cared files
items.contentSnippet:
Git is supposed to be bad at handling mono repos especially where there are many binary files like game projects repo, and also there are no permisson settings, but are important in game development. BlackGit's cli client lets you download only cared files through sparse-checkout(initially not even the default root files) with a mini agent to use natural languages to manipulate the repo, and blackgit's server serves a file level control layer as a proxy to upstreams(github/gitlab)

items.title: What Makes Dual Enrollment Actually Work: Robust Student & Family Support & Career Connection
items.contentSnippet: The third installment in our four-part series with Britebound moves beyond course design to ask a harder question: who is responsible when a student struggles? This post makes the case that robust dual enrollment requires named staff, early drop windows, family scaffolding, and mentors who open doors to careers students have never had reason to imagine. For district leaders building or scaling concurrent enrollment programs, this is the support infrastructure blueprint you have been looking for.
